metaTitle: Custom Canvas Luggage ID Tags | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom canvas luggage ID tags for your team or event. Durable, stylish, and ready for bulk personalization at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Canvas luggage ID tags offer a natural, textured look that stands out from plastic or leather alternatives. The woven fabric accepts screen printing and debossing cleanly, making your logo or contact info highly visible. Ideal for corporate travel gifts, conference swag, or employee recognition, these tags combine durability with a soft, professional feel that holds up to frequent handling.
